The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Court states litigation does not seek to interfere with religious practices; when the Bench asked the counsel if he could place any old Hindu scripture that mandated an idol of Ganesh must be made of PoP, he responded that when the scriptures were being written, PoP was not discovered

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Minor girl held captive, sexually abused by Instagram friend in Nagpur; one held
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The minor from Nagpur went missing on August 2; using technical information, police traced her location and rescued her; she has been admitted to a hospital, police said

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: HC convicts Tarun Tejpal in 2013 sexual assault case, sentences him to 10 years
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Solicitor General Tushar Mehta told the Bombay High Court that Tejpal had shown “no remorse” and urged the Bench to send a clear message that “no means no”

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: BMC MARD calls off doctors’ protest after Bombay High Court’s direction
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The association said the withdrawal was a mark of respect to the court’s directive and the decision was without prejudice to its demands and legal rights

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Why Mumbai is leading India’s super-tall housing boom
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: As Mumbai’s super-tall residential towers rise beyond 300 metres, innovation, redevelopment and sustainability redefine vertical living

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: CBI secures deportation of Red Notice fugitive Vishaka Rathod to India
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Rathod is wanted in connection with large-scale financial fraud and criminal conspiracy with several associates

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: NCP (SP) dissolves State spokespersons’ panel, national spokespersons unaffected
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The move comes amid not just organisational changes, but also speculations about the possibility of support to the BJP

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration places one-year ban on analogue, non-dairy paneer
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The ban includes the manufacture, processing, storage, transport, distribution and sale of analogue/non-dairy paneer

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: CJP backs Jharkhand students’ protest, will work as a pressure group: Dipke
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Abhijieet Dipke says people have “lost faith” in institutions and the credibility of the judiciary, the media and the Election Commission has been eroded

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Bombay High Court seeks response from State, Bar Council on stipend for junior advocates
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The court observes that the issues raised by the petitioners merits consideration in the larger interest of the young advocate community.

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Political discourse still fails women leaders
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: In Maharashtra, Congress is facing backlash for its remarks against the Deputy CM

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: As Ganeshotsav nears, the PoP idol battle drags on in Bombay HC
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Over the past two years, the Bombay High Court has heard multiple petitions seeking restrictions on immersion of PoP Ganesh idols in natural water bodies; the matter remains pending with interim orders issued for the upcoming Ganeshotsav festival

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: BMC doctors suspend routine OPD services, protest MMC registration for CCMP-qualified BHMS practitioners
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The MARD has launched a protest after the Maharashtra government began the process of granting Maharashtra Medical Council registration to BHMS practitioners holding the CCMP qualification

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Bombay High Court questions Police over refusal to file FIR in Disha Salian death case
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: The Bench sought clarification from the State on why the autopsy and ADR reports had not been given to the father since the incident

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Maharashtra government to set a task force for drone policy implementation
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: “The policy need is to strengthen existing drone ecosystem and for that government has to assist the existing companies as well attracting new investments,” Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Four arrested in Mumbai in connection with ₹30 crore Ponzi, multi-level marketing scheme
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Police said the company was accepting illegal investments, even in the form of cash, promising continuous, fixed returns of 5-7% monthly, without obtaining any license/registration from the Reserve Bank of India or the Securities and Exchange Board of India

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Bombay High Court grants protection from arrest to ex-TISS student
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: Court to hear anticipatory bail plea on August 31

The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Title: Dipke set to launch ‘School Thik Karo’ campaign, accuses parties of neglecting govt-run schools
The_Hindu_Maharashtra.Description: “We have made a new Parliament, a new PM house. Why have we not been able to build new schools in our villages? Do we not consider the children of farmers and labourers the future of our country?”, Abhijeet Dipke asked.
